'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***At least seven people are killed and 88 others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[9K720 Iskander|Iskander]] [[double tap strike]] on residential buildings in [[Pokrovsk, Ukraine|Pokrovsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-russian-missile-strikes-apartment-buildings-kill-five-east-2023-08-07/ (Reuters)] [https://news.yahoo.com/russian-attack-pokrovsk-kills-7-102249433.html (''The Kyiv Independent'' via Yahoo! News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/aug/08/russian-strike-on-ukraine-city-kills-five-damaging-hotel-frequented-by-journalists (''The Guardian'')]
***Russian forces strike private houses in Kruglyakivka, [[Kharkiv Oblast]], with [[Guided bomb|guided]] [[aerial bomb]]s, killing at least two civilians and injuring at least five others. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-08-07-23/h_f1fbc3ac0250d1f5d7e7dde8a46cf5bd (CNN International)]
**[[Assassination attempts on Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]
***The [[Security Service of Ukraine]] says that it has arrested a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] citizen for allegedly assisting [[Intelligence agencies of Russia|Russian intelligence]], including his suspected role in a plot to assassinate [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2023/08/07/volodymyr-zelensky-assassination-plot-russia/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Carinthia and Slovenia floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing floods in [[Austria]] and [[Slovenia]] increases to six. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2485750-waterpeil-slovenie-zakt-dodental-door-noodweer-naar-zes (NOS)]
*[[Storm Hans]]
**In [[Sweden]], roads are flooded and a train carrying 120 passengers [[derailment|derails]] in [[Hudiksvall Municipality]], while waves of up to eight meters (26 feet) are reported in [[Denmark]], and several people being evacuated in [[Norway]]. In [[Lithuania]] and [[Latvia]], two people are killed by falling trees, leaving 40,000 customers without electricity in [[Kurzeme District, Riga|Kurzeme]] and [[Semigallia|Zemgale]]. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-weather-storm-cancellation-floods-c12a3e5eab052d33534d19e1ef0caf22 (AP)]
*[[2023 European heat waves]]
**[[Spain]]'s [[State Meteorological Agency]] places [[Andalusia]], [[Castilla–La Mancha]], and [[Extremadura]] on orange alert as the country faces its third [[heat wave]] of the summer. [https://guardian.ng/news/spain-on-heat-alert-as-wildfires-burn/ (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*At least 23 [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] refugees are killed after a boat capsized in the [[Bay of Bengal]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-66470497 (BBC News)]
*Two [[aerial firefighting|firefighting helicopters]] collide in midair in [[Cabazon]], [[California]], [[United States]], killing three firefighters. [https://apnews.com/article/southern-california-fire-helicopter-crash-10d52bcc63b4ab6cc9c8d6285b65d322 (AP)]
*A [[drunk driving|drunk]] wedding guest drives into a wedding in [[Chrouy Neang Nguon]], [[Cambodia]], injuring at least 13 [[Dutch people|Dutch nationals]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2485742-dronken-man-rijdt-in-op-bruiloft-in-cambodja-13-nederlanders-gewond (NOS)] [https://www.dutchnews.nl/2023/08/drunk-driver-ploughs-into-dutch-wedding-in-cambodia/ (Dutch News)]
*Ten people are injured in an [[explosion]] at a grain [[silo]] near [[Derince]], [[Kocaeli Province]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/blast-injures-10-near-grain-silos-turkish-port-2023-08-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Murder of George Floyd]]
**[[Tou Thao]], a former [[Minneapolis Police Department|Minneapolis police officer]], is sentenced to four years and nine months in prison for his role in the murder of [[George Floyd]]. He is the fourth person in the case to be convicted in a [[State court (United States)|state court]]. [https://apnews.com/article/george-floyd-minneapolis-officer-tou-thou-sentencing-586deaeb4d14807ef3f2bdd0196d0b86 (AP)]
*A 29-year-old man is stabbed to death in [[Nea Filadelfeia]] and eight people were injured amidst clashes between fans of [[AEK Athens F.C.]] and [[GNK Dinamo Zagreb]] in [[Athens]], ahead of the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League qualifying phase and play-off round#Q3 CH3.1|2023–24 UEFA Champions League third qualifying round]] between the clubs. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/aug/08/man-dies-after-violent-clashes-between-aek-athens-and-dinamo-zagreb-fans (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Cambodia]]
**[[Hun Manet]] is appointed as the [[Prime Minister of Cambodia|prime minister]] of [[Cambodia]] by [[Monarchy of Cambodia|King]] [[Norodom Sihamoni]], replacing his father, [[Hun Sen]], who had served as prime minister since 1985. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230807-cambodian-king-appoints-hun-sen-s-son-as-new-pm (AFP via France 24)]

**[[Belarusians|Belarusian]]–[[Poles (people)|Polish]] [[Sprint (running)|sprinter]] [[Krystsina Tsimanouskaya]] is cleared to represent [[Poland]] at the [[2023 World Athletics Championships|World Championships]] after being removed from the [[2020 Summer Olympics|Tokyo Olympics]] by the [[Belarus Olympic Committee]].
